item.title: Hollywood unions lock in AI guardrails as tech firms urge industry slowdown
item.description:
Hollywood unions lock in AI guardrails as tech firms urge industry slowdown

Hollywood unions and writers have secured enforceable guardrails for generative AI in entertainment, while heads of major AI companies are calling for an industry‑wide slowdown.

🔍 Overview

  • AI models that generate digital facsimiles of actors and replicate traditional filmmaking tools “pose a threat to some human jobs.”
  • The AI tools used in entertainment production differ from the AI systems that have sparked recent whistleblowing and apocalyptic declarations.
  • Anthropic alignment lead Evan Hubinger warned the technology could “kill all humans” within the next decade.

🛡️ Union Negotiations

  • SAG‑AFTRA chief negotiator Duncan Crabtree‑Ireland said the union recognized early on how AI could impact its members’ livelihoods.
  • “We bargained for and achieved enforceable, meaningful guardrails around how this technology can be implemented by the major employers in our industry,” Crabtree‑Ireland explained.
  • The guardrails do not include companies like OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google directly, but do cover all U.S. entertainment content creators.
  • WGAE executive director Sam Wheeler condemned the “tech oligarchs pushing AI on our society.”
  • The WGAE has long warned that unregulated artificial intelligence poses an existential threat to workers, to our democracy, and to the world.
  • Guild members have bargained meaningful AI protections into their contracts; in 2023 WGA members spent 148 days on strike before studios agreed to real safeguards for film and television writers.

⚙️ Industry Response

  • Hollywood unions’ fight for strict rules around generative AI did not stop the entertainment industry from embracing AI.
  • Alliance of Motion Picture and Television Producers (AMPTP) has been reluctant to adopt demands such as requiring studios to gain permission and compensate actors for AI‑generated replicas.
  • Crabtree‑Ireland noted that without the principle of compensation, “the economic incentive to use replication and to replace human performances would have been much stronger” and would have resulted in “a much greater and faster adoption of digital replication.”

🚨 Risks & Concerns

  • AI‑generated digital replicas threaten certain acting and filmmaking jobs.
  • Prominent AI leaders (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, X) have called for an industry‑wide slowdown on the technology’s development.

🏛️ Political Context

  • President Donald Trump dismissed AI concerns as overreactions.
  • Some other U.S. politicians have felt pressured to take legislative action.

📊 Companies Calling for a Slowdown

Source: What Hollywood thinks about existential AI warnings

item.title: NVIDIA Introduces AIPerf for GenAI Performance Benchmarking
item.description:
NVIDIA Introduces AIPerf for GenAI Performance Benchmarking

NVIDIA has released AIPerf, a ground-up rewrite and the designated successor to GenAI-Perf for measuring AI performance.

🔍 Overview

AIPerf is a multiprocessed system that operates differently than its predecessor by not running on top of Perf Analyzer. The system utilizes worker processes to generate load and separate record-processor services to handle results, with coordination managed over ZMQ.

⚙️ Key details

AIPerf includes the following capabilities:

  • Endpoint Support: Supports over 15 endpoint types, including chat, responses, NIM rankings, and image generation.
  • Dataset Integration: Supports public datasets like ShareGPT and trace replay formats from WEKA (AgentX), Baseten, and Mooncake.
  • Arrival Patterns: Supports gamma, Poisson, and constant arrival patterns with tunable burstiness and gradual ramping for request rate and concurrency.
  • Synthetic Distributions: Includes vLLM/SGLang range-ratio for variable ISL/OSL.

📊 Performance Metrics

Once a run completes, AIPerf writes full results to JSON and CSV and prints a metrics table to the console. Each metric is reported in percentile breakdowns (p25, p50, p75, p90, p95, p99).

Metric Description
TTFT (Time to First Token) How long from request sent to first token received
ITL (Inter-Token Latency) Time between successive tokens during generation
Request Latency End-to-end time for the full response
Output Token Throughput Tokens generated per second across all concurrent requests

🚀 Availability

AIPerf can be installed using uv:

1
2
3
4

uv tool install aiperf
uv venv venv
source venv/bin/activate
uv pip install aiperf

Note: On aarch64, the crick dependency requires a C toolchain (Development Tools on RHEL or build-essential on Debian/Ubuntu) as it ships as source-only.

#NVIDIA #AIPerf #GenAI #Benchmarking #LLM

Source: Benchmarking LLM Inference at Scale with AIPerf | NVIDIA Technical Blog

item.title: Organizations define new specialized roles to secure AI platforms and manage cyber risks
item.description:
Organizations define new specialized roles to secure AI platforms and manage cyber risks

Organizations are establishing new technical roles to manage the intersection of artificial intelligence and cybersecurity, focusing on secure platform design and threat mitigation. These positions address emerging risks in generative AI, cloud infrastructure, and critical industrial systems.

🔍 Overview

The scope of these responsibilities spans from executive leadership to specialized engineering, covering cloud-based Data and AI/ML services, on-premises environments, and operational technology (OT).

🧩 How it works

Role Primary Functions
AI & Security Architect Design secure AI agent platforms, including tools, memory, and models; define controls for sandboxing and human approvals.
GenAI CBRNE Cyber Security Expert Red-team AI models for industrial systems and test safeguards against jailbreaks and adversarial prompts.
Senior Lead Security Engineer – Google Cloud Secure cloud-based Data and AI/ML services and guide engineering teams on security requirements.
Manager Cyber Cloud Security and AI Lead client projects on AI security strategy, governance, and regulatory requirements.
Cyber Engineering Manager Oversee AI/ML-based threat detection and lead security research for Navy cyber-physical systems.

⚙️ Key details

Professional responsibilities within these new frameworks include:

  • Defining security controls for sensitive data, credentials, and agent actions.
  • Managing emerging threats, including post-quantum risks.
  • Assessing vulnerabilities in Kubernetes, CI/CD, and serverless workloads.
  • Monitoring endpoint threats across Windows, macOS, Linux, and VDI environments.
  • Investigating incidents and strengthening detection across Microsoft 365, Azure, and AWS.
  • Designing cyber assessments for DoW programs to identify mission impacts.

💡 Why it matters

These specialized roles are designed to prevent information disclosure and misuse of AI models while ensuring that critical infrastructure and data protection standards are maintained as AI technologies are integrated into enterprise backend services.

#CyberSecurity #AISecurity #GenAI #CloudSecurity #RiskManagement

Source: Cybersecurity jobs available right now: September 15, 2026 - Help Net Security
